BING-DEPENDENCY IS THE STRUCTURAL FACT: referrers last7 = DDG 44.7%, Bing 31.0%, Yahoo 13.6%, Ecosia 4.2% = ~93.5% of organic; Google only 3.5%. The Aug 14-16 spike was Bing-ecosystem indexation, NOT content quality. Content-depth/outbound-sources primarily serve Google, which is the AdSense gatekeeper ('low value content' rejection) — so source work is a monetization unlock, not a traffic lever.
